provenance.note: This artifact materializes the parameter freeze required by the Day22 protocol. It does not make pilot episodes final-benchmark eligible.

selection_rule: Prefer the eligible medium/intensity-rank-2 pilot; selected operational parameter must have been physically tested in the excluded Day23 pilot.

target_offset_or_perception.final_collection_instruction_zh: 方块从 nominal 标记位置沿 Follower 正前方移动 40 mm；机械臂仍执行原 nominal 抓取位置，不追踪、不补偿移动后的方块。

gripper_close_timing.note: Day23 refined the timing intervention operationalization: the robot continues along the nominal clean path and closes only after passing the nominal grasp-close phase. Spatial upward progress is used as the repeatable operator-side phase proxy; the physical cause and changed factor remain gripper_close_timing/gripper_close_phase.
